appliesTo: Future draft only; NOT the authorized unchanged Turbo prompt
performanceHypothesis: Replace the blink count with a single playable listening intention; keep gaze settled and lips at rest, without muscle-by-muscle instructions. This is a writing hypothesis, not a verified fix.
futureVisualPrompt: The man remains seated, listening attentively to the person outside the frame at camera-right. He maintains a settled gaze and relaxed, closed lips; only gentle breathing changes his posture. Locked camera, one continuous three-second shot. Preserve the reference composition, face, wardrobe, table and light. The space at the right edge stays empty throughout. No speaking or singing.
audioPolicy: For picture-only listening tests, prefer enable_audio=false only on models whose live schema supports it and price is rechecked. For an audio test, specify one recognizable, low-level sound with beginning and ending, then check it by ear. Never infer audible content from AAC presence. Turbo exposes no enable_audio switch in the observed contract.
causalityLimit: One v3_0 sample shows failure to obey count and mouth constraints; it does not prove that mentioning blinks caused repetition or that audio enabled caused mouth motion.
